method.windows: One outstanding confirmable GET over loopback UDP, unchanged frozen native client, one current-thread Tokio server per process. 32 warmup operations per window, 1000 ms per-Call deadline. Paced AB/BA has four rounds of 6400 reads at 800/s, capacity three rounds of 3200 reads unpaced. Each 4096-byte read is four verified exchanges. CPU windows begin after warmup. Stack and thread state observers attach in separate 4800-operation windows, each with a matched profiler-off control. Stack counts are inclusive wall-time samples of the event-loop thread. Windows Ready/Standby are runnable, Wait is blocked. Worker snapshots and process CPU are different scopes. No shared tracing changes.

server_capacity.body_bytes: next multiple of 1024 for the requested representation

method.cpu_units: CPU microseconds per verified read for sCPU/cCPU, cycles per verified read for sCycles/cCycles, latency microseconds for p50/p99, operations per second for rate, MiB for private bytes (PB), working set (WS) and peak working set (PeakWS). miss counts late periods. Each row contains a SHA-256 of its complete private window.

four_build_rotation.reason: Every build occupies every position once. Historical and candidate orders reverse in adjacent rounds. A longer capacity gate reduces CPU tick rounding.

method.device: One Waveshare ESP32-S3, 240 MHz, 16 KiB instruction cache, Wi-Fi power save disabled. Automatic, 64-, 256- and 1024-byte Block2 preferences. Eight randomly ordered cycles per boot share a seed within the round. Each operation checked ACK, Content, matching MID/token, block bounds/offset/finality and every representation byte. Boot identification precedes and follows the measured reads. Each build occupies each ordinal once. Device latency includes the Python client, Wi-Fi and scheduler. Client CPU is Windows process user+kernel time during the 64-read mixed window; task-level values for the C firmware are unavailable. Coaptic reports running heap; C reports just before cleanup. Stack below is reservation, not consumed stack.

collection.method: Same client binary in both arms. Only collection mode changes via environment. Exactly one outstanding Call, the same frozen integrated server, 32 untimed warmup reads, 1000 ms deadline. Four paired AB/BA rotations. Verification reads every expected byte. Buffer capacities count only expected bytes and collection output. Four paced rounds of 3200 reads at 800/s and four unpaced rounds at 16384 or 12000 reads.

deadline_local.method: 100000 real method calls per cell on Windows for each of ten paired rounds with alternating build order. Time includes fences and correctness assertions. Timeout-only and write-only cases identify movement of cost. The combined case makes one live history replacement and two deadline queries.

context_setup.method: Public SecurityContext::derive, RFC 8613 C.1. Each call verifies sender key, recipient key and common IV. 50,000 contexts per process, ten pairs in alternating order. Measures setup only.

device_protected.method: Two balanced boot pairs, three native async 24-read processes per boot. Each verifies eight cycles of identity, small value and assembled body. Windows process CPU includes client startup and durable state. Each process rate spans first start through last completion. No energy meter.

device_task_timing.scope: instrumented scheduled-task CPU includes attributed ISR/stall time; readiness is worker observed; no performance gain comparison

device_unprotected_task_timing.method: One native async verifying Windows client, eight cycles, 32 successful UDP request/response exchanges per boot. Ordered end-of-successful-UDP-receive to end-of-send intervals paired by MID and both UDP payload lengths. Sum intervals per completed representation. The same 64-row diagnostic and task clock run in both metered firmware arms. Read-to-send excludes transport wait before arrival, Wi-Fi airtime and other tasks. CPU includes interrupts charged to the servicing task.
device_unprotected_task_timing.excluded_first_capture: The first attempt used a collector allowing COAPTIC_ and LIBCOAP_BENCH_ labels. It discarded READ_MARK rows. It failed grading, restored normal firmware and supplies no CPU observations. All included boots used the corrected collector.

retained_validation.excluded_deadline_probe: Original two binaries had identical .text 39ace9dac816ed... . Full-file hashes differed. The retained timings come from distinct non-workspace dependency builds and a working cache assertion outside timing.

device_context_setup.method: Same ESP32-S3 image. Fresh 16 KiB, core-1 worker for each arm and vector. 128 public SecurityContext::derive calls per worker, verified against independently calculated sender key, recipient key and common IV. Clocks bracket only the verified loop. Stack watermark sampled before and after. Six AB/BA pairs per vector per boot.

packet_phases.method: Four Im/Cm/Cm/Im boots. Each matched 96 bounded timestamps to 24 verified reads, 32 complete exchanges, and the original client message IDs and request/reply lengths. First timestamp after receive, second immediately before sendmsg/sendto, third after successful send. Sum matching stages across both exchanges. CPU includes any interrupt time charged to this worker. The service and capacities match the ordinary comparison.

role_lookup_candidate.method: The current and candidate native clients borrowed complete responses from identical service capacities and used the same shipping server executable. All four matched pairs per cell were profiler-off and capacity-limited by one outstanding Call. Local role lookups used one fixed slot and eight or 64 allocated slots. On the candidate, fixed/allocated storage scanned key and role by reference. Its public fallback retained snapshot lookup for custom backends. The known role-specific method was asserted outside local timings.
